prompts.name: app-icon
prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. The attached identity board is the authoritative reference image, not content to reproduce as a board. Faithfully match its Sidefolk Folk Family design, proportions, friendly soft clay/plastic 3D shading, navy #0F2D5B, aqua #2ED4D9, coral #FF7B6B, mint #7DD3A7, light blue #93C5FD. Main companion is a squat smooth white rounded dome/body with a large navy rounded visor and exactly two aqua upward-curved smiling eyes, no mouth, no antenna, no legs. Four little rounded helpers surround it: coral above waving to the right, blue behind left, mint front left, light blue right. Preserve recognizable arrangement and avoid redesigning. No labels, captions, watermarks, surrounding board, or extra objects. Asset type: final macOS app icon, single centered square export. Match the top right APP ICON MOCKUP exactly in spirit and geometry: a softly raised white rounded square tile occupying roughly 82% of a square transparent canvas with generous equal outside margins and soft restrained shadow. Group sits within tile, coral above, blue left, mint lower left, light blue right, main companion in front lower center. Two small aqua emphasis rays upper right. No text anywhere. Straight-on, no perspective, no external mockup, crisp at small sizes. Actual transparent outside the tile. Produce large square master.

prompts.name: logo-clean
prompts.prompt: Edit target: attached Sidefolk stacked logo. Produce the SAME exact characters, composition, lettering, shapes, and palette as a reusable transparent PNG cutout. REMOVE ALL colored background glows, halos, haze, bloom, drop shadows and any semitransparent washes surrounding every shape. These were unwanted. Every visible character, white shell and text stroke must be fully opaque. Only the empty spaces surrounding the silhouette and between letters must be fully transparent with narrow antialiased edges. The navy Side text and aqua folk text must be solid clearly defined rounded lettering exactly reading Sidefolk. Transparent canvas must have a generous clear empty margin on all four sides. Preserve art; no tile or backdrop. This is an actual isolated logo asset, not a presentation or scene.
